months.note: 국내에서 기록된 달이며(1962년 11월 서울 근교, 2015년 5월 소청도), 번식지에서는 7월 하순~8월 상순에 알을 낳는다.

summary: 볏과 식물이 빽빽하게 자란 초습지에 사는 새로, 갈대숲 깊이 숨어들어 잎과 줄기 사이를 이리저리 걸어 다니며 먹이를 찾는다. 나비목과 메뚜기목 곤충을 즐겨 먹는다. 둥지는 땅에서 27~35cm 높이의 풀잎이나 줄기 사이에 틀고, 7월 하순~8월 상순에 한배에 5~6개의 알을 낳는다. 북쪽에서 번식하는 무리는 겨울에 남쪽으로 내려가며, 구북구 동부, 일본, 만주 등지에 분포한다.

art.subject: Marsh Grassbird (Megalurus pryeri), adult (sexes alike), as seen on autumn passage in Korea: upperparts buff from forehead to uppertail coverts with black shaft streaks, broad on the crown, mantle and scapulars and narrow on the hindneck and rump; faint pale supercilium; pale brown lores and ear-coverts; wings brown with buff feather edges; chin, throat and centre of breast and belly white, unstreaked; sides of breast and belly warm buff; long, strongly graduated brown tail; thin brown bill with a darker brown culmen; dark brown eye; pale brown legs.
art.pose: clambering between dense reed stems, side view
art.scene: dense reed and sedge marsh in Korea during autumn migration, reeds turning buff with feathery seed heads, soft daylight; no people, buildings or text
views: adult, side view clinging to an upright reed stem: buff upperparts with bold black streaks on crown, mantle and scapulars, faint pale supercilium, white throat and centre of breast and belly, buff sides of breast and belly, long graduated tail, pale brown legs gripping the stem
adult, head in side view: thin brown bill with darker brown culmen, faint pale supercilium, pale brown lores and ear-coverts, dark brown eye, black-streaked buff crown
art.build: A small, slender, long-tailed marsh warbler, 12.5cm, with a body smaller than a sparrow's; nearly half the length is tail. Rounded head with a flat forehead and no crest. Bill thin and fine, slightly shorter than the head, with gently rounded culmen and lower edge. Legs medium, pale brown, with strong feet for clinging to reed stems. Wings short and rounded; at rest the wingtips barely pass the base of the tail. Tail long and strongly graduated, with narrow, rounded feathers, often slightly cocked or fanned. Flight short and weak, low over the reeds with the tail spread.
avoid: Do not paint plain, unstreaked upperparts; that is a reed warbler such as Oriental Reed Warbler (Acrocephalus orientalis).
Do not paint a bold white supercilium with a black stripe above it (Black-browed Reed Warbler); the supercilium is faint.
Do not give it a short tail with white tips (Zitting Cisticola); the tail is long, graduated and plain brown.
Do not streak the white throat, breast or belly.
